info.title: Jeweler Pro API
info.description: Jewellery-business management API. Money is shown as decimal TL in responses and stored as integer kuruş. Every /api route except authentication requires a bearer access token. All data is scoped to the caller's business. Keep this document in sync with the routes: test/openapiContract.test.js fails when a route is missing here or a documented route no longer exists.

Forbidden.description: Missing permission, another business, or TENANT_MISSING

error.description: Human-readable message (Turkish); clients localise by code
